title: End Stone Protector
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Mob |stats = {{InfoboxMobStats |health = 5,000,000 |defense = 150 |damage = 1,200 }} |category = Boss |spawn_location = [[Dragon's Nest]] |mob_level = 310 |mob_type = *{{mt|Construct}} *{{mt|Ender}} |mob_drops = *1-10 Enchanted End Stone *1 End Stone Rose *0-3 Crystal Fragment *0-1 Golem Pet *0-1 Tier Boost Core *0-1 End Stone Protector Shard |id = CORRUPTED_PROTECTOR_100 }} The '''End Stone Protector''' is a [[Mob]] and {{MobCategory|Boss}} that spawns in several locations in the {{Zone|Dragon's Nest}} after {{Green|5,000}} {{MobSprite|Zealot}}s are killed across the server. == Spawning == The '''End Stone Protector''' spawns in a number of predetermined locations in the {{Zone|Dragon's Nest}}. {{Green|5,000}} [[Zealot]]s must be killed in order to summon the boss. The '''End Stone Protector''' spawns in {{Green|5}} stages: * {{DarkGray|'''Resting'''}} - Phase 0 * {{Gray|'''Dormant'''}} - Phase 1 * '''Agitated''' - Phase 2 * {{Yellow|'''Disturbed'''}} - Phase 3 * {{Gold|'''Awakening'''}} - Phase 4 * {{Red|'''Summoned'''}} - Phase 5 This can be seen in the player's [[Tablist Widgets]]. === Game Message === {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Message |- | class="ct" | {{Green|1,000}} {{MobSprite|Zealot}}s killed | {{Dialogue|&cYou feel a tremor from beneath the earth!}} |- | class="ct" | {{Green|5,000}} kills reached | {{Dialogue|&c&lThe ground begins to shake as an End Stone Protector rises from below!}} |} == Behavior == The '''End Stone Protector''' attacks the nearest player and rapidly swings its arms, tossing the player into the air and dealing damage. It only targets {{Green|1}} player at a time. The '''End Stone Protector''' also has {{Green|2}} abilities. * '''Toss:''' All nearby players who are on the standing on the ground are tossed into the air and take {{Stat|tdmg}}. * '''Crush:''' The '''End Stone Protector''' summons chunks of {{Item|Block of Iron|link=|text=Blocks of Iron}} in the air and crushes players with them, dealing {{InfoNeeded}} damage. Upon death, a platform constructed of {{Item|Block of Iron|link=|text=Blocks of Iron}} with a {{Item|Beacon|link=}} in the center is generated, similar to the platforms spawned by {{MobSprite|Ender Dragon}}s. Players can pick up loot here. == Drops == {{Mob Drops Table |level = 310 |coins = 775 |orbs = 930 |combat_xp = 2,325 }} The drops a player receives from killing an '''End Stone Protector''' are calculated based on their loot Quality, which is calculated with this formula: \text{Quality} = \text{BaseQuality} + \text{ZealotsKilled} + 50\cdot\frac{\text{PlayerDamageDealt}}{\text{FirstPlaceDamageDealt}}
Up to 100 killed Zealots will contribute to the player's Quality. Base Quality is determined by the damage placement of the player: {| class="wikitable centertext" ! Condition !
